content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required authorization was absent, and the payer’s 14-day retro-authorization window is closed; peer-to-peer is unavailable and a necessity appeal has already been attempted. CO-197 is a contractual/provider-liability denial, so the balance cannot properly be transferred to the patient despite the remaining deductible, and no further compliant payer action can cure the authorization failure.","action":"write_off"}
